**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Update the threat table to name the renamed cadence test**

This trust-boundary row claims item 1g is pinned by `test_boundary_cadence_is_stated_once_a_day`, but that selector does not exist; the implemented test, validation record, and corrected `revise.yaml` all use `AgmsgOrchestrationRuleTest.test_boundary_cadence_is_stated_between_integrations`. Consequently, a reviewer following the residual control cannot run the test it cites, and the task's evidence no longer accurately describes the control that mitigates this rule change. Update this row (and the corresponding non-historical task specification) to reference the actual selector.
